case_brief.subject: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PMVBRY)
case_brief.administering_body: Ministry of Labour and Employment through the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO)
case_brief.what_it_is: The Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana is an employment-linked incentive scheme designed to stimulate job creation and formalize the workforce. It provides financial assistance to first-time employees and incentives to establishments for generating additional employment, with a specific focus on the manufacturing sector.
case_brief.entitlement: Part A provides a one-time incentive of up to ₹15,000 to first-time employees. Part B provides incentives to employers for two years for creating additional employment, or four years for establishments in the manufacturing sector.
conditions: The employee must be a 'first timer' to qualify for Part A incentives.
The establishment must generate additional employment over and above the calculated baseline to qualify for Part B incentives.
The establishment must file an Electronic Challan-cum-Return (ECR) with the EPFO.
The incentive is only provided for employees for whom the prescribed provident fund contribution has been received by the EPFO.

For Part A and Part B, the first 'Completed Wage Month' is determined by the date of joining: if joined on or before the 5th of the month, that month counts; if after the 5th, the subsequent month counts.
common_failure_reasons: Failure to file the Electronic Challan-cum-Return (ECR) with the EPFO.
Non-receipt of provident fund contributions for the specific employee.
Failure to meet the threshold criteria for additional employment over the established baseline.
case_brief.official_grievance_channel: The scheme is administered by the Ministry of Labour and Employment through the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO). Grievance redressal is handled under the administration of the scheme as outlined in the official guidelines.

draft:
I am writing to formally lodge a grievance regarding the non-receipt of benefits under the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PMVBRY). My details are as follows: Name: [Name], Aadhaar Number: [Aadhaar Number], and Employer: Indiamart Intermesh Ltd.

I am a first-time employee, and my employer, Indiamart Intermesh Ltd, has confirmed that they have generated additional employment above the established baseline. The establishment has filed the required Electronic Challan-cum-Return (ECR) with the EPFO, and the prescribed provident fund contributions for my employment have been received by the EPFO.

I joined the establishment on October 1, 2025. Under the scheme guidelines, the first completed wage month is determined by the date of joining, where joining on or before the 5th of the month qualifies that month for incentive calculation. I request the EPFO to verify my records against these criteria and confirm my eligibility for the PMVBRY incentives.

Please conduct a formal review of my application and provide the status of my benefit disbursement. I request that you provide a grievance reference number so that I may track the progress of this matter through the official EPFO grievance portal.
